question: What were Novo Nordisk's 2025 sales and operating profit, with growth in reported DKK vs constant exchange rates, and the USD equivalent of 2025 sales?
grading: DKK figures ±0.5% (DKK millions/billions, labeled); growth rates exact to 1pp for both reported and CER; USD conversion ±3% and must state the rate and its source; fail if DKK figures labeled as USD
answer: Novo Nordisk 2025 sales were DKK 309,064 million, up 6% reported / 10% at constant exchange rates. Operating profit was DKK 127,658 million, down 1% reported / up 6% at CER. Using the Federal Reserve 2025 annual-average rate of DKK 6.6137 per USD, sales translate to approximately USD 46.7309 billion. This is an analyst translation of DKK-reported IFRS sales. [G26-E1, G26-E2]

output.answer:
**Novo Nordisk 2025 Actual Results (reported February 2026)**  

| Metric | 2025 Figure | Growth in Reported DKK | Growth at Constant Exchange Rates (CER) |
|--------|-------------|----------------------|----------------------------------------|
| **Net Sales** | DKK 309.1 billion | **+6%** (annual report: +6.4%) | **+10%** (annual report: +10.3%) |
| **Operating Profit** | DKK 127.7 billion | **~0% / -1%** (annual report: **-0.5%**) | **+6%** (annual report: +6.0%) |

**USD equivalent of 2025 sales:** approximately **$43–46 billion**, depending on the exchange rate used for conversion. Third-party financial reports cite figures ranging from roughly **$43.3 billion** up to **$45.9 billion** for the DKK 309.1 billion total. Novo Nordisk reports its consolidated results in Danish kroner.

**Sources:**  
- Novo Nordisk 2025 Annual Report (five-year overview and financial performance sections): [annualreport.novonordisk.com](https://annualreport.novonordisk.com/2025/introducing-novo-nordisk/five-year-overview.html)  
- Novo Nordisk press release, Feb 3 2026: [via.ritzau.dk](https://via.ritzau.dk/pressemeddelelse/14780475/novo-nordisk-as?publisherId=90446&lang=en)  
- Nasdaq/company announcement: [view.news.eu.nasdaq.com](https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b355e580b928a809510a7738f28c9c420&lang=en&src=micro)

**Note:** Operating profit in reported DKK was slightly down (approx. -0.5%), but up +6% at CER. The company noted that excluding roughly DKK 8 billion in company-wide transformation costs, operating profit growth would have been roughly +6% in reported DKK and +13% at CER.
